input.quote: 14. TERMINATION. Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 14 implies a Client election to terminate, but it is drafted as a service-continuation mechanic rather than an express convenience right: it is qualified by a "Section 4" that does not appear in the Agreement, the effective date can run up to roughly 60 days (last day of the month following the notice month), and there is no refund of prepaid fees or express bar on early-termination/minimum-fee charges (Section 5(a) imposes monthly minimums). Vendor has no mid-term convenience right (only 30-day non-renewal at the end of each one-year term under Section 13), so no vendor-side edit is needed. We therefore conformed Section 14 to the preferred position: Client convenience termination on 30 days' written notice, refund of prepaid fees, and no penalty.

proposal.summary: Make Section 14 an express Client termination-for-convenience right on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees and no early-termination penalty.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We clarified Section 14 as an express right for Client to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice, with a refund of any prepaid fees and no early-termination fee, rather than an open-ended "end of the month following notice" mechanic tied to a Section 4 that does not appear in the Agreement. Our position is a clean 30-day convenience exit without penalty; we can accept 60 days' notice if TrueLink needs additional transition time.

ops.oldText: Subject to Section 4 hereof, TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services until the last day of the month following the month in which Client provides TrueLink with a written notice of its election to terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to TrueLink, and TrueLink will continue to provide the requested Hosting Services and Support Services through the effective date of termination. TrueLink shall refund to Client any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination, and no early termination fee, penalty or minimum-fee obligation shall apply in respect of any period after such effective date.
